explainer_content.short_definition: Reggaeton and urbano pop where dembow rhythm, Spanish hooks, and global pop scale meet.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Daddy Yankee opens the route through reggaeton gateway hits, while Bad Bunny shows how urbano became a flexible album-scale pop language.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It marks one of the most important 21st-century shifts in global pop center of gravity.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The rhythm is the map: even crossover tracks usually keep a bodily dembow pulse or percussive vocal logic.
